hero.title: FLUTTER & .NET DEVELOPER
hero.name: Ahmet Basmacı
hero.description: Passionate mobile and web developer with expertise in Flutter, .NET, and modern development frameworks. Experienced in AI tools and prompt engineering to create innovative solutions and publish successful mobile applications on Play Store.

about.paragraph1: I am a dedicated and passionate software developer with a strong background in mobile and web development. My journey in technology has led me to specialize in Flutter for cross-platform mobile development and .NET for robust backend solutions.
about.paragraph2: With experience in publishing multiple applications on Google Play Store and working with various technologies, I bring a comprehensive understanding of the full development lifecycle. I leverage AI tools and prompt engineering to enhance productivity and create innovative solutions. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and tackle challenging projects that push the boundaries of what's possible.

islamicApp.title: Zad-Almumin: Islamic App
islamicApp.description: A comprehensive Islamic mobile application that provides Quran reading, daily supplications (Azkar), Hadith collections, prayer times, and Islamic reminders. Features beautiful UI design, multi-language support (Arabic, English, Turkish), night mode for reading, and various Islamic tools including the 99 names of Allah with explanations.

hadithBooks.title: Hadith Books Collection
hadithBooks.description: A comprehensive Flutter application containing 15+ authentic hadith books including Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and other major collections. Features advanced search functionality, bookmarking system, offline reading capabilities, and clean Material Design interface.

alkotMobilya.title: Alkot Mobilya Business Manager
alkotMobilya.description: A comprehensive business management application designed for furniture companies. Features inventory management, room-based collaboration system, image upload capabilities, and real-time data synchronization with Arabic interface support.

mandalawiQuran.title: Mandalawi Quran Recitation Academy
mandalawiQuran.description: A modern Islamic education management platform that connects Quran teachers with students. Features comprehensive user role system, enrollment management, progress tracking, and tajweed level assessments with real-time notifications.

tradesmensNotebook.title: Tradesman's Financial Notebook
tradesmensNotebook.description: A comprehensive business finance tracking application designed for tradesmen and small business owners. Features expense and income tracking, profit calculations, currency exchange integration, and detailed financial analytics.

asaltnaQuiz.title: Asaltna - Islamic Quiz Application
asaltnaQuiz.description: An interactive educational quiz application focused on Islamic knowledge with multiple question categories, sound effects, progress tracking, and custom animations. Features Arabic language support and engaging user interface.

flutter.title: Flutter Developer
flutter.description: Developing cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter framework. Working on various client projects and contributing to the company's mobile development initiatives.

dotnet.title: .NET Developer
dotnet.description: Developed web applications using .NET framework, ASP.NET, and C#. Worked on backend systems and API development for various client projects.

independent.title: Independent Mobile App Developer
independent.description: Published and maintain several mobile applications on Google Play Store, gaining experience in the complete app development lifecycle from concept to deployment.
